correctness.rationale: Rosenmann strip-normal classification limits edge directions to x,y,x-y and at most six sides. Five sides force a rectangle with one diagonal equal-leg corner cut, A=ab-u^2/2 and P=2(a+b)-u. Exact expansion P^2-14A=7(a-b)^2/2+8(u-(a+b)/4)^2 proves sharpness and unique scale/isometry family. Four sides are parallelogram or trapezoid endpoint with exact deficits 4(a-b)^2 or (2a-3b)^2; triangle endpoint always P^2=18A. General P^2>=12A with ball equality is explicitly cited prior. Independently simplified all symbolic deficits and independently checked rational polygon coordinates/perimeters, including strict-equality examples; the normal-form exhaustiveness—not random finite tests—supplies the family theorem.
